name: ARAL Reading Bagacay ES
description: Offline-first DepEd ARAL-Reading remediation app for Bagacay Elementary School (KS1 Grades 1-3 & KS2 Grades 4-6) with Philippine English & Filipino TTS, 2-try hints/mini-lessons, 5-color mastery badges, PDF Messenger reports with repeated-wrong tracking, and JSON Backup/Restore.
